tei:div.tei:p: oṃ dharma dha du na mo na maḥ oṃ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos can gyis stong zhing dben la dag pa'i gzhi/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ rang byung ye shes bde ba chen po gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa'i mthar thug pa cha med kun 'gro khyab pa po/ 'gal 'dus skyon med 'jig rten dpe las 'das shing*/ rten 'brel dang*/ rtog ge dang*/ rnam shes las 'das pa'i dbyings dang ye shes gcig tu 'dres pa/ so sor rang rig ye shes kyi spyod yul/ don dam bde gshegs snying po pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa/ mthar thug gi sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ rgyud dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyag rgya thams cad 'dus pa du ma ro gcig srid zhi dbyer med/ 'khor 'das dbyer med bden gnyis dbyer med bsal bzhag med pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal/ rang bzhin lhan skyes/ rang bzhin 'gyur med/ myang 'das chen po/ dbu ma chen po/ phyag rgya chen po/ sher phyin zab mo/ gzhan stong chos kyi sku/ mkha' khyab la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de rnams gsal bar ston pa'i gsung rab zab mo rnams kyi nang nas/ 'dir snying po'i mdo lnga ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs/ lha mo dpal 'phreng seng ge'i sgra'i mdo/ rnga bo che chen po'i mdo/ sor mo'i 'phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo rnams so/ /de yang dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ lnga pa ni mdo sde na bzhugs la/ gsum pa ni dkon brtsegs na bzhugs shing*/ gnyis pa ni gzungs 'bum nang na'ang bzhugs so// yang de rnams kyi steng du/ stong nyid chen po'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo/ sprin chen po'i mdo rgyas pa/ myang 'das chen po'i mdo rgyas bsdus gsum gcig tu byas pa ste/

de ltar lnga bsnan pas snying po'i mdo bcur yang 'gyur zhing*/ 'di rnams phal cher ni mdo na bzhugs la/ myang 'das ni zur na bris pa'ang snang ngo*/ / yang nges don mdo lnga ni/ sher phyin lnga brgya pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rab tu dbye ba'i le'u cha bcu gnyis byams zhus su'ang grags pa gnyis gcig tu bsdus pa/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo rnams so/ /de rnams las dang po ni/ shes rab sna tshogs na bzhugs shing*/ byams zhus gnyis ni khri brgyad stong pa dang*/ nyi khri lnga stong pa na bzhugs la/ lhag ma gsum ni mdo sde na bzhugs so/ /yang de rnams kyi steng du/ gser 'od dum chen/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa/ lang kar gshegs pa/ ye shes snang brgyan gyi mdo/ sangs rgyas phal po che rnams bsnan pas nges don mdo bcu ste/ dang po bzhi ni mdo sde na bzhugs shing*/ dang po dang tha ma ni zur na bzhugs pas rab tu grags so/ /de ltar snying po'i mdo lnga mdo bcu nges don mdo lnga mdo bcu ni/ nyung la mos pa rnams kyis kyang gdon mi za bar gzigs dgos la/ rgyas par ni bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur mtha' dag gzigs dgos shing*/ zab mo'i rnal 'byor yang nges par bsgom dgos par gda' bas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnam dag la thos bsam sgom gsum rnam dag yongs su rdzogs par mdzad par zhu/ zhes thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba zhe thag pa nas 'debs pa lags so/ /zhu don gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ rton pa bzhi ldan gyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //sarba maṅga laṃ/ shubhaṃ/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gsung*/zhu don gnang ba/ - PAGE 198 -- PAGE 197 -- PAGE 196 -
